items.q: Leon was in there a very short time.

ctx.x: I see a trombone player here named Leon Cox who I've never heard of before. Who was he?
Leon was in there a very short time. And see, there's many of them that would come in, stay a short few weeks and then go. So --
(Inaudible) -- was there for a few months in '61 it says here.
